name: Valletta · Malta
tagline: A golden fortress capital in the heart of the Mediterranean
summary: Valletta, Malta's tiny honey-stone capital, was built by the Knights of St John and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. From here explore the Grand Harbour, Caravaggio, prehistoric temples older than the pyramids, and the blue waters of Gozo and Comino.
seasonNote: Hot summers; spring and autumn are ideal. Village festas fill summer weekends.
arrival: Malta International Airport is 20 minutes away by bus or taxi. Ferries from Sicily.
gettingAround: Walk Valletta; buses cover the island; ferries to the Three Cities, Sliema and Gozo.
cashTip: Cards are widely accepted; buses take cards or the Tallinja card, and small kiosks like cash.
foodTip: Pastizzi, rabbit stew and ftira sandwiches.
buyTip: Maltese lace, filigree silver and Mdina glass.

connections.note: Or a ferry to Pozzallo then a drive.
